note: The festival tag (AR12). A shard's picture keeps its place and size; the tag is laid over it. Every size here is in points, and `side` is the side a shard's picture is shown at, as Config.Hud.ShardArt counts it. DESIGN, untried in Studio.

tag.when: the large picture is shown (the side is Config.Hud.ShardArt.Large or more)
tag.tieAtNote: where the thread's top is tied, from the picture's middle, in sides: right and up of it
tag.plaqueNote: the plaque's height in points is side times `ofSide`; the image is shown plaque / 24 times its own points, its `tie` on `tieAt` (research, 2026-11-15: a quarter of the crystal at 96 points and a third at 50, so the mark stays about the same height on screen)
tag.boxesNote: worked out for five sides: the image's left and top from the picture's middle, its width, its height

mark.when: the small picture is shown, down to a chip
mark.note: the image's side is the picture's side times `side`, never under `least` points; its middle lies at `middle`, in sides, from the picture's middle: at the crystal's foot, on the right

chip.when: a chip, where the picture is 26 points
chip.note: no image: a band of the ground's colour along the chip's foot, `band` points high, inside the chip's own edge

name.note: everywhere a shard's name is shown: "Lantern Row" over "Prismatic Shard"

later: the other four grounds' tags are drawn when their grounds are built. Mask Parade's leads with gold and carries the mask in violet (research, 2026-11-15).
